model_annotation: The chart illustrates the number of participants associated with different evaluation “Criteria” categories, shown as a horizontal bar chart. The category axis is vertical and labeled “Criteria,” listing (from top to bottom) Relevant FCs, FC Summary, Relevance Explanation, Clarity and Simplicity, Criteria, Overall Summary, Filters, and Veracity Explanation; the categories appear arranged in decreasing bar length. The value axis runs horizontally and is labeled “Number of Participants,” using a linear scale with visible tick labels at approximately 0, 2, 4, and 6 (spanning roughly 0 to 6). Each category is represented by a single solid bar with a green-to-purple gradient (lighter green for the smallest bars and darker blue/purple for the largest), and several bars have numeric value labels placed near their right ends: Relevant FCs is the longest dark purple bar at about 6 participants, FC Summary is slightly shorter in dark blue/purple at about 5, Relevance Explanation and Clarity and Simplicity are mid-length teal/blue bars at about 3 each, Criteria is a shorter green/teal bar at about 2, and the remaining lower categories (Overall Summary, Filters, and Veracity Explanation) are short light-green bars around 1 participant each; no bars are stacked or grouped, and there is no separate legend or special visual emphasis beyond the color ramp and the end-of-bar value annotations.
